effects.prompt: Put an Illusionist aura card with cost 0 from your hand into the arena?

_comment:
'When Coalescence Mirage is destroyed, you may put an Illusionist aura card with cost 0 from your hand into the arena.'

Phantasm appears in printed_keywords: it fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.phantasm_check) and is deliberately NOT authored here - authoring it again would be a defect.

Trigger: TRIGGERED + ON_DEATH, the spelling shipped cards use (evr/phantasmal_haze_red.json - same Illusionist-attack death-trigger family). The engine dispatches ON_DEATH from effect_keywords.destroy's 'destroyed' event (engine.py:1578-1588), so release note 1 holds structurally: being cleared from the combat chain, or leaving the arena by any non-destroy route, never emits it.

Put clause: MOVE_MATCHING reads to_zone plus the canonical dict target (effect_types.py:3593-3612). zone HAND is in _OBJECT_TARGET_ZONES (effect_types.py:418-420); destination_player_id defaults to obj.owner (= me). Filters verified against their handlers: CARD_IS_CLASS reads 'classes' (condition_types.py:1286-1307); CARD_IS_TYPE reads 'subtypes' and tests types AND subtypes (1309-1325); CARD_COST_LTE reads 'amount' (1219-1255) - 'with cost 0' is LTE 0 because costs are never negative. to_zone 'auras' resolves via Player.zone_by_name (state.py:1030) through put_object -> Zone.add, which is where Illusionist auras live.

Caveat 1: the MAY prompt is offered even when no matching card is in hand; accepting then does nothing (empty pool, no move). Printed CR would not offer the option at all. No existing condition cleanly expresses 'your hand contains a card matching <filter>' (CARD_IN_ZONE's filter is cost-shaped only), so it is left ungated - fails closed rather than fabricating a gate.

Caveat 2 (release note 2): 'if not in the arena when destroyed, no trigger' is not explicitly gated. SELF_IN_ZONE exists but I could not verify what card.zone reads for a card sitting on the combat chain as the attack; a wrong zone string would silently kill the legitimate Phantasm-death trigger, which is worse than the rare edge case. A card outside the arena is essentially never destroy()'d in this engine, so the ungated trigger matches the shipped phantasmal_haze_red shape.
